name: VERITAS
full_name: Very Energetic Radiation Imaging Telescope Array System
summary: US ground-based very-high-energy gamma-ray array conducting combined indirect searches of dwarf spheroidal galaxies and other dark-matter-rich targets.
detection_principle: Four telescopes measure Cherenkov images of the same atmospheric shower; multi-target likelihood analyses constrain the dark-matter annihilation cross section.

status.label: Operation supported by evidence
status.evidence: Collaboration's 2024 results page and institutional facility page.

key_parameters.name: Representative combined-analysis sample
key_parameters.value: 17 dwarf spheroidal galaxies; not the total of all observations over all years

results.summary: Combined dwarf-galaxy searches set dark-matter annihilation-cross-section upper limits.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
